EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for registering for the Overnight Experience as part of your Scholar Day event at the Downtown Phoenix campus. Please keep this email confirmation for your records.
Overnight Experience arrival information Date: Wednesday, Nov. 11 – Thursday, Nov. 12, 2015 Check-in: 5 – 5:30 p.m. Program: 5:30 p.m. – 8 a.m. Location: Check-in at the dining facility in Taylor Place. 120 E. Taylor St. Phoenix, AZ 85004
Overnight Event driving and parking
Parking requires a reservation or you will be ticketed. If you wish to park on the Downtown Phoenix campus, contact Susan Estby at Susan.Estby@asu.edu to make your reservation. Once you make a reservation, you will be allowed to park in the McKinley Visitor Parking Lot located on McKinley Street between First Street and Second Street. Please park in one of the lot’s numbered spaces. View driving directions (http://www.asu.edu/map/directions.html) and a map of parking locations (http://www.asu.edu/parking/maps/downtown-current.pdf).
Please note: Students will not be permitted to leave campus once checked-in to the program.
What to bring Bring a change of clothing, sleeping bag, pillow, towel and any personal items (medication, soap, etc.). If you need to borrow a sleeping bag, please let Susan Estby know at Susan.Estby@asu.edu. To store your luggage during Scholar Day, bring it with you to the Nov. 12 check-in at 7:30 a.m.
What to send ahead of time All participants must complete student waivers to stay overnight in the residence hall. If you are under the age of 18, you must have your parent or guardian complete the form. Email the completed form to Susan Estby at Susan.Estby@asu.edu.
Student waiver form: https://drive.google.com/a/asu.edu/file/d/0BwVFAJYFrO9wRGl1U2JIcGVObXc/view
Scholar Day check-in Please note that Overnight Experience participants will be provided breakfast before the day’s events begin.
Check-in begins Nov. 12 at 7:30 a.m. in the Barrett Suite in University Center 160 (UCENT) for students who stayed overnight or those who want to depart from the Downtown Phoenix campus. We will then transport you to the Tempe campus for the Scholar Day programming.
Guest information Guests may participate in the Scholar Day event on Nov. 12. Please refer to the confirmation email you received for the Scholar Day program to coordinate your guest’s arrival time and meeting location. For guests planning to stay overnight, check out special ASU rates at local hotels and information regarding the city of Phoenix and surrounding areas. Special rates: https://visit.asu.edu/enhance/dtphx#link-lodging Phoenix information: https://www.phoenix.gov/visitors
Transportation will be provided between the Downtown Phoenix and Tempe campuses for students and guests.
Parking option 1: Guests may select to park at Tempe campus (use visitor parking in the Apache Boulevard structure, Rural Road structure or Fulton structure) and meet their student there, travel to Downtown Phoenix campus and return to Tempe campus.
Parking option 2: Reserve parking at Downtown Phoenix campus (use numbered spaces in the McKinley Visitor Parking Lot) through Susan Estby at susan.estby@asu.edu, travel to Tempe campus, and return to Downtown Phoenix campus.
If you have questions regarding this event, please contact Susan Estby. We’re looking forward to hosting you for this exciting event.
Sincerely,
Naomi Hillsman Assistant Director Admission Services 602-496-2035 visit.asu.edu
If you would like any additional information or have questions related to this subject, please reply to this email.
